item.text: “I’m happy to lend you tools, and I appreciate how carefully you’ve treated them. I’ve noticed the last two returns were later than we had agreed, though, and I sometimes need to plan around having my tools available. In the future, could we agree on a specific return time before you borrow something, and could you let me know in advance if you need it longer? If the timing is uncertain, I may need to hold off on lending it or suggest another option. I value being good neighbors and want borrowing to remain easy and comfortable for both of us, so this small boundary would help me feel confident lending tools again.”
